info.name: Navilla API
info.description:
API collection for Navilla - Privacy-preserving sexual health platform.

## Setup

1. Set `baseUrl` variable to your API URL (e.g., `http://localhost:8080` or `https://api.navilla.app`)
2. Get a JWT token from Supabase Auth and set it as `accessToken`
3. Run the collection to test all endpoints

## Authentication

All endpoints except public health check require a valid Supabase JWT token in the Authorization header.

item.name: Lab Verification
item.description: Lab provider listing and two-step verification flow (verify then confirm)

request.description: List all enabled lab providers with their required credential fields. Public endpoint (no auth required).
Step 1: Initiate lab verification for a test visit. Calls the lab provider API and caches results for the confirm step. Either visitId or testDate must be provided.
Step 2: Confirm and save lab verification results. Must be called after a successful verify step. Retrieves cached results and persists them to the visit.
